facts.fact: Bonnie 直觉这场合作是个坏主意，而 Dr Levingworth 把这种直觉归因于她加重的焦虑症
facts.anchor: Every fibre in Bonnie’s body warned her this was a bad idea

facts.fact: Bonnie 最厌恶迟到；她早对 Bailey 说过这个提议很糟，但经理从不听她的
facts.anchor: But one matter especially irked her: people being late

facts.fact: Frank 为 Madison 的迟到道歉，说乐队很荣幸有机会与她合作
facts.anchor: Sorry about this. We are honoured to potentially work with you

facts.fact: 助理 Scarlett 上饮料：Frank 黑咖啡、Kamaria 巧克力奶、Bonnie 冰姜蜂蜜茶，Bonnie 纠正她别叫 Miss Bloom
facts.anchor: A coffee for Frank, chocolate milk for Kamaria, and iced ginger and honey tea for Miss Bloom

facts.fact: Madison 迟到，与 Bailey 搂着肩膀大笑进门，进了屋仍不理睬 Bonnie 也不道歉
facts.anchor: Bailey burst in with his arm around Madison’s shoulders, deep in a fit of laughter

facts.fact: Bailey 提出方案：两张专辑各收录一首合作曲，两种曲风两批粉丝能带来热度
facts.anchor: I think it’s in everyone’s best interests to feature on one song from each album

facts.fact: Madison 当面质疑：粉丝可能不接受，讥讽 Bonnie 是 Princess Bubblegum、彩虹小马，Bonnie 反唇相讥她是阴间吐出的吸血鬼残次品；Madison 又指出 Bonnie 牙上有口红
facts.anchor: You’re all rainbows and sparkles, like a My Little Pony

facts.fact: Bailey 辩称专辑需要爆点安抚董事会、Madison 嗓子极好、录音只几天；Bonnie 妥协答应但撂下狠话
facts.anchor: Fine, but this better be worth it, Bailey
